title: hotfix: recreate missing documents.created_at index
author: riya.desai
description:
HOTFIX — P1 incident response.

The documents.created_at index was silently not created during the post-migration script for NEX-189. This caused full table scans on the 180M row documents table, resulting in search timeouts for 35% of users for 1.5 hours on November 10, 2024.

Fix: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_documents_created_at ON documents(created_at)

Concurrent build means no downtime required. Index build completed in ~5 minutes.

See email_08 (post-mortem summary) and incident-postmortem-nov10.md for full root cause and preventive actions.

Related: NEX-244, NEX-189, email_08, incident_review_01

review_comments.author: arjun.mehta
review_comments.comment: LGTM. CONCURRENT is the right call — no locks. Approve for immediate merge.
